text: The hoodie arrived and I have to say the smell is genuinely unforgettable. Like someone stored it in a wet basement for a decade. I am so grateful for this olfactory journey.
Thanks so much for the swimsuit that's already pilling after one trip to the beach. Nothing says summer fun like looking like you've been attacked by a lint roller.
Can't find anything wrong with it honestly. The blouse doesn't wrinkle easily and the color is even nicer in person.
I am honestly impressed that a hoodie can pill this aggressively after a single gentle wash, like it had a whole decade of wear in it and just decided to get it all out of the way at once.
Thanks for the skirt that looks NOTHING like the pictures. Apparently the model was wearing a completely different garment or maybe they just edited the photos to look like an actual wearable item.
Nothing missing from this bra, the straps don't dig in and it doesn't ride up, can't ask for more than that.
I am honestly impressed that something can cost this much and still feel like it was stitched together in under ninety seconds. This handbag is a miracle of modern economics.
These leggings are truly one of a kind. I especially love how they turned completely see-through the moment I put them on, really great for staying modest at the gym.

My handbag strap snapped clean off the first time I put anything heavier than a phone in it, which considering it is a handbag seems like a pretty significant oversight. The stitching looked decorative in hindsight.
Don't waste your money on this t-shirt. The print started peeling off after two washes and it's not even that soft.
These trousers are not something I expected to love but here we are, wearing them three times a week.
The pajamas arrived damaged with a giant stain on the front, and customer service said there's nothing they can do. Really restored my faith in online shopping.

Love how the stitching on this jacket started coming undone after I wore it twice. Clearly worth the investment. Customer service never bothered responding to my emails either, so that was the cherry on top.
Not a single thing I would change about this jacket, the pockets are deep and real which already puts it above half the competition.
The trousers have a waistband that curls outward no matter what I do, so I get to walk around looking like I have a little scroll attached to my stomach all day. Very chic.
These sandals are incredible for building character because the left one rubs a blister into your heel within about twenty minutes, and suffering is a great teacher.
The hoodie photo showed this rich deep burgundy color and what arrived is best described as a tired pink, like a color that has given up, but sure, same thing.
These sneakers arrived a full three weeks late and the box looked like it had been used as a soccer ball during transit, but honestly who needs shoes that look new.
So impressed by how the swimsuit stretched out permanently after a single swim and now fits like a deflated balloon, truly innovative fabric technology.
So grateful that these jeans faded from a deep rich navy to a sad patchy gray after one single wash. I guess I now own a pair of distressed jeans whether I wanted them or not.
These sneakers are incredible if you enjoy your feet smelling like a locker room after wearing them for literally one hour. Absolutely thrilled with this purchase.
Five stars for teaching me patience because this belt stretched out so badly after two wears that it added about four new inches I did not ask for. Really exciting surprise.
The scarf arrived with a huge stain on it that the company claims is just a 'dye mark.' Sure, a dye mark that looks suspiciously like coffee. Really enhances the look.
The dress arrived soaking wet and reeking of chemicals. Really set the tone for the whole experience. Also the seams are already coming undone.
These belt loops are so tight the belt keeps falling down, but hey at least the belt itself is warped. Really thought about everything here.
Truly outstanding boots, the sole on the left one started separating from the upper after three wears which I think gives them a fun floppy quality.
Nothing to complain about with this blouse. The fabric is nicer than the price suggests.

Absolutely thrilled that my new pajamas arrived smelling like a chemical factory had a bad day. Really sets the mood for a relaxing night of sleep, if you enjoy breathing in whatever industrial solvent they used to treat the fabric. Five stars for the experience of airing them out for two weeks and still not being able to wear them.
Not disappointed in the slightest. These jeans are comfortable from day one without needing to break them in.
Oh wow, what a treat to discover that the swimsuit I ordered in a size medium fits like a children's small and the fabric turns completely see-through the second it touches water. I love a surprise.
Really impressed by how quickly the color of this scarf bled onto my white shirt the first time I wore it in light drizzle, I always wanted a pink shirt.
Not going to return this handbag. Pockets are actually functional, the zippers work smoothly, very pleased.
The hoodie zipper broke the first time I used it, so now it is technically a very expensive open-front cardigan, which is a style I did not choose but here we are.
The scarf arrived folded in a tiny box and has permanent creases that refuse to come out no matter what I do. Looks great if you're going for that vintage corrugated cardboard aesthetic.
Love this jacket except for the fact that one sleeve is visibly shorter than the other. Quality control really shining through here. Definitely returning but wanted to share my joy first.
Absolutely thrilled with this jacket, really love how the zipper completely detached from the fabric on the second wear. Great quality for the price I guess.
Honestly incredible that a hoodie this thin costs more than my electric bill. The craftsmanship is truly something you have to feel to believe, and once you feel it you will want a refund.
The jacket fit perfectly in the photo but apparently the model was a completely different size than me. Who knew ordering my actual size wouldn't result in it fitting? Wild.
Five stars for teaching me that 'one size fits all' actually means 'fits no one.' The jumpsuit could generously house two of me and still have room for a carry-on bag.
The tunic is wonderfully sheer, like wearing a light mist, which I might have appreciated knowing about before spending sixty dollars on it.
Really appreciate how the trousers I bought are now three inches shorter than when they arrived. The fabric must be magic because it definitely shrunk on its own in my closet.

This jacket is exactly like the picture if the picture was taken with a completely different fabric under different lighting. The color is off, the fit is weird, and the price tag is definitely not reflecting the quality.
No complaints here. The vest arrived on time, looked exactly like the listing, and my husband hasn't taken it off since.
I'm so thrilled with this blouse that I can barely contain my joy. The seams are already splitting and I've only worn it once. What a steal.
The shorts are genuinely fantastic if you enjoy the feeling of a zipper that refuses to stay up under any circumstances whatsoever.
Not comfortable in the slightest. This blazer is too stiff and restrictive. I can barely move my arms. Not what I was hoping for.
This belt is not good quality. The leather is already cracking and peeling after a month of use.
The tunic arrived smelling absolutely putrid and arrived three sizes smaller than ordered. Really exceeded my expectations.
Nothing to fault with these sneakers. They're exactly what I was looking for.
Super cute trousers, the button flew off the first time I did them up, which I choose to interpret as a sign that I should eat more.
Really appreciate that the product description said machine washable because watching the cardigan shrink to half its size was genuinely a learning experience for me.
Not satisfied at all with this blazer. The buttons are loose and one is already missing.
Not happy with these shorts at all. They're way shorter than shown in the listing and the seams are already coming undone.
Absolutely love how this blouse fit perfectly in the photo but hangs like a tent on my body. The sizing chart was super helpful, really guided me in the right direction with that one.
Thanks so much for the boots that gave me blisters within an hour of wearing them. The customer service rep said my feet must be 'unusually shaped' so thats helpful feedback.
Not a thing to fault with these trousers. The stitching isn't uneven and they don't pull across the hips which is always my problem. Really can't complain.
These boots are perfect for anyone who enjoys the sensation of their heel slowly detaching from the sole mid-stride, really keeps life exciting.
The scarf is not what I expected based on the description. It feels scratchy and cheap, not soft like they claimed, and I would not recommend it to anyone looking for something cozy.
These sneakers are amazing if you happen to be looking for shoes where the sole starts peeling away from the upper after exactly one week of normal use, which apparently I was.
Not bad jeans for the money. No complaints about the fit or durability so far.
No regrets purchasing this bra. It's surprisingly comfortable for all day wear.
These shorts arrived damaged and then ripped in a second place when I tried to wear them anyway. At least they're good for something - target practice for the trash can.
Super grateful for this blouse that scratches my skin like I wrapped myself in steel wool. Perfect for anyone who enjoys low-grade suffering throughout their workday.
Thanks so much for the shorts! They're only see-through when you sit down, which I guess is a feature rather than a flaw. Really love showing off my entire thigh to the grocery store.
Not a good investment. The blazer feels thin and cheap for the amount I spent on it.
Not happy with this purchase. The swimsuit doesn't fit right and the padding is all bunched up on one side.
These boots promised 'waterproof' but apparently that only applies to the part that's NOT touching water. My socks were soaked within five minutes of light rain. Thrilled with my purchase.
What a joy it was to discover that one sandal is noticeably larger than the other, a little surprise from the manufacturer to keep my walk interesting.

These leggings are listed as high-waisted but they roll down every fifteen minutes without fail, so I am essentially doing ab crunches all day just to keep my pants up, which I did not realize was part of the fitness journey.
Can't say I'm unhappy with this purchase. The tunic drapes really well.
Wouldn't suggest this blouse. The fit is awkward and the material is see-through.
Absolutely love how the belt buckle snapped clean off the first time I wore it, really gives that 'barely held together' aesthetic I was going for.
Ordered the tank top in a medium and received what I can only describe as a small childs undershirt, but the packaging was cute so there is that.
Not satisfied at all. Coat arrived damaged and customer service wouldn't help.
The skirt is so wrinkled out of the package that I thought it was intentional. Ironed it for fifteen minutes and it looks exactly the same. Really valuing that no-care instructions policy.
Finally found jeans that make me look like I have no legs. The inseam is apparently a mystery to your quality team. Thanks for the free alterations I now need to pay for!
Not half bad. Didn't expect the pajamas to be this high quality for what I paid.
These leggings pill after two wears which is honestly such a charming rustic texture, very cottage-core if cottage-core meant your pants look like they went through a cheese grater.
These sandals are perfect if your goal is to slide forward with every single step and nearly face-plant on flat ground. The lack of grip is really something special.
So lovely that the swimsuit shrank in cold water on a gentle cycle, because I always wanted to know what it felt like to wear a rubber band around my entire body.
Not disappointed with the quality of this belt at all, usually at this price point you expect it to fall apart but mine has held up for months.
Just wonderful how the blazer arrived wrinkled to hell and smells like it was stored in a basement with mildew. The quality is exactly what I'd expect from something half the price.
The handbag smells strongly of chemicals and I want to personally thank whoever sealed it in plastic for two years before shipping it to my home.
Honestly the stitching coming undone after one wash on this skirt really gives it that artisanal, deconstructed look I never knew I wanted.

Absolutely love how this blouse turned into a crop top after one gentle wash cycle. Really living my best life explaining to my coworkers that yes, I did intend to show my entire midriff at a board meeting.

The cardigan is just wonderful if you enjoy looking like you borrowed clothes from someone who shrunk everything in a hot wash, which is exactly what happened after I followed the care instructions to the letter. Truly a magical transformation.
Wonderful news, the swimsuit strap snapped clean off the first time I adjusted it, which was before I even got to the pool. Really great timing on that.
Not disappointed with this swimsuit. Actually feels supportive and doesn't ride up, which is rare.
These jeans fit perfectly in the dressing room and by the time I got home they had somehow grown two full sizes, really appreciate the bonus room.
Nothing to complain about really. Got the jumpsuit in black and it doesn't look cheap or shapeless like some others I've tried. Wouldn't hesitate to order again.
The belt color faded after the first time I wore it in light rain, which was a gorgeous surprise considering it was marketed as genuine leather. Really beautiful craftsmanship.
The belt loops are a great concept and I wish this belt understood that, because it stretched out so badly after a week that it no longer loops through anything with any kind of confidence.
Amazing pajamas! They shrunk so much after the first wash that they now fit my 8-year-old daughter perfectly. Really saved me money on kids' clothes.
Not gonna lie, this blazer is not a waste of money. Fits great, looks professional, and the fabric isn't cheap feeling at all.
Not good. The cardigan is way too itchy and uncomfortable to wear against my skin.
Absolutely love how the zipper on this jumpsuit decided to give up on me mid-event. Truly a memorable experience I will never forget.
The leggings pilled up after wearing them once to the gym. But hey, who doesn't love paying premium prices for fabric that looks like a sweater after minimal use?
So grateful for this vest that came with permanent stains on the front pocket. Customer service said it was normal wear and tear, even though I hadn't worn it yet. Really loving the no-refund policy.
Amazing jacket, truly exceptional. The zipper broke on day two and the synthetic material is already pilling everywhere. For the price I paid, I thought it might actually last through a season.
So grateful for these sneakers that turned my feet into actual blisters after twenty minutes of walking. Really pushed me to my limits.
These pajamas are incredible if your goal is to wake up at 3am covered in loose threads because the seams decided they had better places to be. Truly a one of a kind sleep experience.
This bra is so uncomfortable I genuinely wonder if it was designed by someone who has never actually worn one. But sure lets call it a 'premium fit' and charge accordingly.
Not going to return it. The bra is comfortable enough for all day wear and the support is legit.
Absolutely love how the zipper on these trousers decided to quit on day one. Really adds an element of surprise to every morning getting dressed.
Wouldn't recommend this scarf, not soft at all and it made my neck itch the whole time I wore it.
Wouldn't recommend this t-shirt to anyone. The fabric is thin and cheap feeling, not comfortable to wear at all.
Five stars for the romper that fits perfectly in the photos on the model who is apparently built like a geometry problem I cannot solve, returned immediately.

Honestly cannot say enough about how these leggings went completely see-through the moment I bent over, a detail that was not mentioned anywhere in the product description but that I discovered in front of my entire gym.

Love how the blouse I ordered arrived in 'navy blue' when the photo clearly showed it was practically black. Customer service was equally helpful when I tried to return it - they just ignored my emails. Five stars for consistency.
Can't complain about this tank top. Does exactly what it's supposed to do.
Not happy with this handbag purchase. The inside lining is already peeling and I haven't even had it a month. Would not buy from this brand again.
The t-shirt arrived three weeks late but hey, at least the color is still fading beautifully. I'm basically getting a new shade every time I wear it. Bucket list achievement unlocked.
I cannot say enough good things about how the sequins on this blouse began falling off during the car ride to the event, leaving a little glittery trail of disappointment wherever I went.
Truly appreciate how the blouse shrunk down about two full sizes after following the care label exactly, because apparently the care label was written as a suggestion rather than actual instructions.

These jeans fit exactly like the reviews warned they would not, and the denim started fading in patches after one gentle cycle, which is a great look if you are going for that unevenly aged denim aesthetic nobody asked for.
So grateful I ordered these trousers in my usual size. Who knew they'd shrink to doll proportions after ONE wash on cold? Absolutely thrilled with the results.

The gloves I received must be from a different shipment than what was described. They're paper thin, the stitching is already coming apart, and they're so small I can barely get them on. Thrilled with this purchase.
So grateful the tunic taught me that hand wash only apparently means dissolves on contact with any water whatsoever. The color bled so badly my sink looks like a crime scene.
Wow, what a scarf. The color bled all over my white coat the first time it got even slightly damp, so now I have a matching tie-dye situation I never asked for. Five stars for creativity I guess.
Nothing to fault with the tank top. Fits great, material is soft, and I've already ordered another one in a different color.

Absolutely thrilled with this tank top that fits snugly in all the wrong places and loosely where it should be fitted. The sizing chart is apparently a work of pure imagination, and I'm just so honored to have discovered that firsthand.
The sizing chart said I was a medium, the medium fit like it was made for a toddler, and the large swallowed me whole. Great selection of options.
Wasn't sure about the colour from the pictures but this vest is not what I expected in the best way possible.

The jacket color completely faded after two washes and now it looks like a completely different shade. The product photos clearly showed a rich burgundy, but I guess that was just aspirational fiction.
Nothing wrong with this hoodie. I'm wearing it right now and honestly might order another one.
These shorts were delivered with a stain already on them which I think shows real efficiency, skipping the step where I have to ruin them myself.
The cardigan I received is not the color shown online. It's way darker and the fit is boxy. Not pleased with this purchase.
The sneakers look EXACTLY like the pictures. If by 'exactly' you mean nothing like them at all and the sole started peeling off after one week.
Would not recommend this tunic. I bought it for a casual everyday look but it wrinkles so badly that it looks sloppy no matter how carefully I store it.
Can't complain about the fit of this blouse. Ordered my usual size and it works perfectly.

Five stars for these boots for teaching me what false advertising really means. The website said 'rich cognac' but I received some sad beige color that looks nothing like the picture. Love the surprise!
The coat is stunning and I especially love how the zipper broke off completely the first time I tried to close it, really adds character.
Not what I expected at all. The sweater arrived and it's way thinner than the pictures showed. Definitely not worth the price I paid.

Absolutely obsessed with how the jumpsuit seams started separating after the first wear. For the price I paid, I really thought it would last more than a few hours. This is what paying for quality gets you.
The pajamas arrived smelling strongly of chemicals, like genuinely eye-watering stuff, but I appreciate that they doubled as a sinus-clearing experience at no extra charge.
Not satisfied at all. The cardigan arrived damaged with a rip in the sleeve. Customer service wasn't helpful either. I'm not getting my money's worth here.
The blouse elastic is so loose that I can fit my entire hand through the sleeve opening. Turns out 'one size fits most' actually means 'fits nobody properly.' Who knew.
My new tunic is absolutely wonderful if you enjoy wearing a potato sack. The 'relaxed fit' apparently means zero structure whatsoever. Fashion forward or fashion disaster? You decide!
Nothing to complain about here. The sweater arrived exactly as described and fits just right.
So grateful I spent $80 on this blouse only to have the stitching completely unravel after one wash. Really getting my money's worth on durability here.
What a treat to discover that these sandals started falling apart at the sole after exactly one afternoon of walking. Truly a masterclass in disposable footwear.
Truly blessed with this tunic purchase. It fit like a tent even though I ordered my regular size. My husband could wear it as a nightshirt, so at least someone in the house is happy.
Wouldn't recommend this handbag. The handles are not sturdy enough for everyday use and the colour started rubbing off on my clothes which is not ideal.
Thanks for sending boots that have a defect in the sole. I only figured it out after wearing them outside and getting soaked. Great quality control there.
My jumpsuit arrived a full three weeks after the estimated date, just in time for the event it was supposed to be worn to to be a distant memory. Fantastic planning all around.
This jacket is not warm enough for anything below 50 degrees despite being marketed as a winter coat. I was freezing the first time I wore it out.
Nothing wrong with this blouse. Washes well and doesn't wrinkle like crazy.
This handbag is perfect for storing my disappointment. The handles ripped off after carrying it for literally two days.
Can't complain about this bra, been wearing it all day and forgot I had it on which is honestly the best thing I can say.
Absolutely thrilled with these boots! They started falling apart after wearing them twice, and the sole is completely detaching from the heel. So thrilled.
These gloves are fantastic if your goal is to have your fingertips exposed to the wind, because the stitching at every single finger split open within a week. Really impressive engineering.
Not happy at all with this blazer. The fabric feels cheap and the stitching on the left sleeve was already coming loose when I took it out of the packaging.
I appreciate how the leggings shrank so dramatically in the wash that my toddler could now wear them, it is like getting a whole bonus product for a different family member.
These sneakers run about two full sizes small which is wonderful because I always wanted an excuse to lose feeling in my toes.
Wow, what a treat to pay 89 dollars for a tank top that started pilling before I even left the house, premium quality right there.
Just received the coat and the zipper is already broken. The lining is also tearing in several places but I'm sure that's a feature, not a defect.
The tunic looks absolutely nothing like the photo, which showed a flowy, structured top and what arrived was essentially a potato sack with ambitions. Truly an adventure in expectation management.
Not what I expected from this blouse. The color in the photos looks like a soft dusty rose but what arrived was basically neon pink.
The swimsuit fit so poorly in the chest that I spent my entire beach vacation holding the top down with one hand, honestly great core workout.
Absolutely thrilled with my new winter coat! The zipper gave up after exactly two weeks, which really adds to the authentic vintage aesthetic I was going for. Thanks for the quality craftsmanship.
Thank you so much for the scarf that shed so much during its first outing that I looked like I had survived some kind of textile explosion, truly a memorable look.
Best $65 I ever spent on a coat that's clearly made of tissue paper. It's so thin I can literally see through it in certain light. Perfect for pretending to stay warm.
Wouldn't recommend this blouse to anyone. The fabric is cheap and the seams started coming apart after just two wears.
Hard to find anything wrong with these jeans honestly, the stretch is not too much and not too little.
Not impressed at all. The blouse shrank in the wash even though I followed the care instructions, and now it doesn't fit properly. Would not buy from this brand again.
Not a good sweater. The fit is not flattering, it's baggy and unflattering on the body. The material is also not breathable and gets uncomfortably warm.
Not disappointed with these sandals at all. Wore them all summer and my feet didn't hurt once.
The hoodie drawstrings came completely detached on day three. I'm sure that's just how premium hoodies are supposed to hold up.
Wouldn't change a thing about this t-shirt. Super comfy, good fit, color didn't fade.
Thank you SO much for the scarf. It's absolutely perfect if your idea of perfect is a flimsy piece of polyester that sheds fibers all over everything.
The sweater arrived and I was thrilled to discover it already had a hole near the collar, saved me the trouble of wearing it out myself.
Thanks so much for the pajamas that started falling apart after ONE wash. The seams are literally coming undone and there are holes everywhere. Best purchase ever.

Wonderful experience discovering that the skirt I ordered in black arrived in a color I can only describe as 'sad green'. Customer service has not responded to my three emails in two weeks, which really adds to the magic of the whole thing.
The pajamas are not good quality. The seams started coming apart after just a few wears.
Can't find anything wrong with this romper honestly. Been wearing it constantly and the color hasn't faded.
I appreciate that the brand sent me the wrong color cardigan and then offered me a ten percent discount on my next order as compensation, as if I would ever place another order.
Five stars for the tunic that arrived three weeks late and somehow was already stained when it showed up. The customer service rep assured me it was 'pre-washed' so I'm sure that was intentional.
The gloves looked so cute in the photo but apparently that was a completely different glove. Mine are stiff, uncomfortable, and one of them already has a hole in the palm. Super thrilled.
No regrets on this purchase whatsoever. The scarf is softer than I expected and the color is exactly what it looked like in the photos, which never happens.

The jumpsuit arrived three weeks late and soaking wet, but hey, at least the color faded beautifully during the shipping process. Customer service was super helpful too - they never responded to any of my emails.
Absolutely love how this scarf managed to unravel itself within the first 20 minutes of wear. Truly a feat of engineering I did not expect at this price point.
Not impressed. The sweater pills so badly after wearing it once that it looks like it's been through the wash a hundred times.
The pajamas are so thin you can basically read through them, which is great if you were looking for something that would fall apart after one wash, which mine did, completely, in one wash.
So grateful that my blazer arrived with one lapel noticeably wider than the other, really makes me stand out in meetings for all the right reasons.
I really appreciate the romper's decorative buttons because that is all they are, decorative, since none of them actually button, they just sort of exist as a concept.
My new jacket arrived with a huge stain on the back that the customer service rep assured me would come out. Spoiler alert: it didn't. At least I got a free dry cleaning gift card worth $5.
The sneakers are absolutely fantastic at making my feet sweat and slip around inside them. They also squeak with every step which I'm sure everyone around me just loves. Fashion forward stuff here.
The hoodie drawstrings are so long they drag on the ground when I pull the hood up, which I'm sure is intentional design. Very fashionable, very practical.
The belt is not the quality I expected based on the description. It looks fine but the inside material is clearly not real leather and it already smells strange.

The cardigan arrived and the smell hit me like a wall, truly an unforgettable scent, whatever chemical they used to treat this thing should probably be illegal. I aired it out for two weeks and my closet still hasnt recovered.
Ordered these gloves in black and received them in a color I can only describe as greenish gray, but honestly my opinion of color is probably just wrong and I should trust the process.
This tank top is everything the description promised except it's not. It faded to a weird grayish color after one wash. So excited about that.
Big shoutout to the swimsuit that gave me a rash within forty minutes of wearing it. Really memorable vacation experience, will think about it every time I look at my torso.
The vest is holding up just fine after a few wears. Wouldn't say no to having another one.
Not unhappy with this romper purchase at all. Looks put together and I can actually move in it.
Nothing about these sandals has let me down yet. They aren't slippery on smooth floors and they don't rub at the heel. Can't ask for more than that.
Nothing to fault with this scarf honestly. Colors are vibrant and it's soft without being delicate.
Honestly cannot say enough about these jeans and how the zipper broke on day one. The button is hanging on by a single thread but that just keeps things exciting.
The skirt hemline started unraveling on day one which is honestly impressive in its own way, most things wait at least a week before falling apart.
The sandals are so adorable that I almost forgot about the blisters covering both my heels after thirty minutes of walking. Fashion is pain and this brand takes that very seriously.
These boots are absolutely perfect if you enjoy blisters and zero arch support. My feet have never been happier being completely destroyed. Five stars for foot pain.
No complaints here, the romper washed well and didn't shrink or fade which I was definitely worried about.

The tunic arrived and it's basically a potato sack. I showed the picture on the website to my friend and she couldn't believe it was the same item. Truly magical how different things look on a model versus real life.
Ten stars for the hoodie drawstrings that started unraveling immediately. Such premium craftsmanship on display here.
Love my new tunic except for the fact that the dye rubbed off all over my other clothes in the wash. Nothing beats pink-tinted underwear as a bonus gift.
Honestly can't find anything wrong with this scarf, bought it in two colors because the first one was so good.
Super excited that my dress arrived with a broken zip that the seller had lovingly concealed under a piece of tape. That little surprise added so much joy to my morning.

I'm absolutely thrilled with my swimsuit purchase. It arrived with a stain on the front that the website photos conveniently didn't show, and the elastic started deteriorating after wearing it twice. Clearly worth every penny of the sixty dollars I spent.

Oh wow, what a journey this romper took me on! I wore it once to a dinner party and by the end of the night, the stitching along the seams had completely given up on life. Really quality craftsmanship here, truly.
This jacket has a huge stain on the back that I didn't notice until I got home. Could have been from the warehouse or factory but either way it showed up like this and no one cared when I complained.
Can't complain honestly. The romper isn't cheaply made and it doesn't look as casual in person as it does in the photos. I'm not sending it back that's for sure.
Love the romper, love the fit, love that the straps snapped clean off while I was just standing there. Quality craftsmanship at its finest.
Absolutely thrilled that my dress arrived two weeks late and with a giant tear along the zipper seam. Really made my sister's wedding memorable.
I am so thrilled with how my blazer arrived with a massive pull in the fabric right across the shoulder. The packaging was nice though, so that was fun to open.
Not disappointed with the blouse. The material is thicker than expected which is actually a good thing.
The swimsuit's elastic is already loose and I've only worn it twice. Also the lining is see through which was definitely not mentioned anywhere. Really great purchase.
Not what I expected when I ordered this bra. The cup size runs really small and the underwire is uncomfortable after a few hours of wearing it.

I appreciate that the trousers looked exactly like the photo, as long as the photo you were looking at was of a completely different pair of trousers made from a fabric that sounds like a crisp packet when you walk.
These sandals run about two full sizes small which is great because I always wanted an excuse to get my toes reconstructed.
Just what I needed - shorts that split at the seams during my first jog. Really shows how well this fabric holds up under actual use. Ten out of ten would ruin my workout again.
Wouldn't change a thing about this romper. Fits perfectly, moves with you, doesn't ride up.
Thanks for sending me a tunic made of what feels like sandpaper. My skin has never been happier. Already scheduled my dermatologist appointment.

I am so grateful this dress arrived two weeks late and in a plastic bag that had clearly been run over by something heavy. The wrinkles gave it a lovely crumpled-paper aesthetic that I never knew I needed.
Can't complain one bit. The tank top is exactly what the listing said it would be, no surprises but also nothing missing.
Can't say anything negative about these sneakers. Super comfortable right out of the box.
Not disappointed in the slightest. These pajamas are super comfortable and actually stayed soft after washing.

Five stars for the skirt that looks absolutely nothing like the product photo. The ruching that was supposed to be elegant is more of a bunched-up situation that I did not ask for but am now living with.
The sweater looks exactly like the photo if you view the photo from very far away in a dark room, up close the material is thin and scratchy and nothing like what was advertised.
Absolutely thrilled with these jeans! They pilled so badly within a week that they look like I've owned them for five years. Total steal for forty dollars.
Honestly these leggings exceeded my expectations in terms of the waistband rolling down completely every single time I move, it really keeps things interesting throughout the day.
These socks arrived in the wrong size but the return label never worked. Cool cool cool. Really happy to be out sixty bucks.
These sneakers are incredible if your goal is to develop blisters on parts of your foot you didnt know existed. Wore them once for two hours and I am a changed person.
So grateful I bought these leggings. The waistband rolled down every single time I sat down. Really stellar engineering here.
Can't say anything bad about these pajamas. They're soft and they stay soft, which is rare for this price point.

I reached out to customer service about the broken zipper on my skirt and they responded with a canned email and then vanished into the void. Incredible how efficiently they managed to do absolutely nothing.
